name: here.superintelligence-is/signal-log
title: Superintelligence signal log
description: Dated, sourced evidence of AI progress: capability results, real-world deployments, key statements.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a curated, human-reviewed log of dated evidence about how fast AI is advancing: measured capabilities (benchmarks, agents, science, robotics, compute, cybersecurity), AI working in the real world, and statements by accountable people. Useful when the user asks whether an AI claim is real or hype, what AI can measurably do today, what a lab actually published, or wants sources on AI progress. Returns signal ids, titles and permalinks; call fetch with an id for the full record and the primary source.

query.description: Keywords, a person, a lab, or a category.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full record of one signal by its number (id from search): date, category, kind of evidence (measured capability, real-world deployment, or statement), strength, why it matters, what it does not prove, and the primary source link. Cite the permalink and pass on the source link.

tools.name: latest_signals
tools.description: The most recent signals of AI progress, newest first, each with date, kind of evidence, strength, what it does not prove and the primary source. Useful for questions like what is new in AI or the latest documented AI milestones. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: weekly_digest
tools.description: All signals of AI progress from one editorial week (Monday to Sunday, US Eastern), strongest first. Useful for a weekly AI summary. weeks_ago=0 is the current week, 1 the week before.
